threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly to put the small FluxMessageChannel regression in an existing test suite instead of the new fluxChannelTest suite. The user accepted this approach and invoked /cloud to implement it. Do not create another PR.

Move FluxMessageChannelTest.java from the javaagent module's src/fluxChannelTest/java source set into src/test/java, keeping the existing package. Remove the fluxChannelTest JvmTestSuite registration, its explicit Spring Integration 5.5.20/Reactor 3.4.29 dependencies, and its testcontainersBuildService exception from instrumentation/spring/spring-integration-4.1/javaagent/build.gradle.kts. Keep the necessary Reactor testInstrumentation dependency. Reuse the regular test suite and its existing latest-dependency configuration; do not raise the regular suite's baseline dependency versions or change version41Test.

Preserve the minimal normally agent-instrumented AnnotationConfigApplicationContext with @EnableIntegration and a FluxMessageChannel bean, subscription outside the producer scope, actual channel.subscribeTo(source) path, delivery assertion, producer -> process application.fluxChannel -> handler parentage assertions, context restoration, bounded waits, and cleanup. Do not replace agent wiring with a manually attached interceptor, weaken parentage assertions, bypass subscribeTo, or subscribe under the producer span.

The version distinction matters: FluxMessageChannel was introduced in Spring Integration 5.0, so this test cannot go into version41Test. Older 5.1 implementations of subscribeTo execute synchronously, while 5.5.20 inserts publishOn(boundedElastic()). The regular suite's existing latestDepTestLibrary("org.springframework.integration:spring-integration-core:5.+") configuration should exercise the asynchronous handoff. Confirm the latest-dependency execution actually covers that handoff, not just the synchronous older baseline. Keep any necessary version-dependent assertion small and use the existing testLatestDeps convention rather than adding a new suite or version pins.

Run the module's narrowest applicable spotlessApply before behavioral validation. Run the moved regression in the normal test configuration and with -PtestLatestDeps=true, and run the existing version41Test to confirm its baseline remains intact. Use the existing Gradle conventions and report the exact commands, resolved Spring Integration/Reactor versions relevant to the two regression executions, and outcomes in your completion report. Do not use clean, disable caches, or force reruns without concrete stale-output evidence.

This remains test coverage only. Do not add production changes, HTTP, RabbitMQ, Docker fixtures, Spring Boot/Cloud Stream dependencies, queued-element context guarantees, artificial scheduler gating, or sleeps. Preserve this PR's draft state. Leave PR #20920 and issue #3096 unchanged.

replies.body: Moved the regression into `src/test/java`, removed the dedicated suite wiring, and added a latest-deps thread assertion for the asynchronous handoff in commit `64d652ce`. The regular run passed on Spring Integration 5.1.6 / Reactor 3.2.10, and `version41Test` passed. The latest-deps run could not reach the tests because unrelated Helidon configuration requires unavailable JDK 27.

@copilot Complete the missing latest-dependency runtime validation for this PR. The suite move is delivered in 64d652ce9523f4354c457b90fbe95c6b0375c347 and has a clean Copilot review. The normal regression passed on Spring Integration 5.1.6 / Reactor 3.2.10 and version41Test passed, but the actual asynchronous latest-dependency path has not executed because configuration of unrelated Helidon modules requires unavailable JDK 27.

Try Gradle's --configure-on-demand option so the targeted Spring Integration task does not configure unrelated Helidon projects. Start with ./gradlew --configure-on-demand -PtestLatestDeps=true :instrumentation:spring:spring-integration-4.1:javaagent:spotlessApply :instrumentation:spring:spring-integration-4.1:javaagent:test --tests '*FluxMessageChannelTest'. This is a scoped validation attempt, not permission to fix unrelated build or JDK requirements.

Keep the regression in the existing src/test suite and preserve its latest-dependency different-thread assertion, actual FluxMessageChannel.subscribeTo handoff, normal agent interceptor wiring, span parentage assertions, and context restoration. Do not downgrade or override dependency versions, bypass or disable the asynchronous assertion, reintroduce a suite, edit settings or Helidon build files, change production code, or add infrastructure. Do not run clean, disable caches, or force reruns. Do not change files merely to create a commit if validation passes.

Report the exact command and result, the resolved Spring Integration/Reactor versions in the latest-dependency execution, and whether the different-thread assertion actually ran successfully. If configuration-on-demand is also blocked, report the concrete first error and whether any test executed rather than claiming the asynchronous path passed. A small in-scope correction to this regression is authorized only if the actual latest-dependency test reveals a real defect in it; preserve the intended behavior and run the narrow formatter before validation after any such edit.

Update this PR directly if a test correction is required; do not create another PR. Keep the draft state and leave PR #20920 and issue #3096 unchanged.

replies.body:
Ran the requested command exactly: `./gradlew --configure-on-demand -PtestLatestDeps=true :instrumentation:spring:spring-integration-4.1:javaagent:spotlessApply :instrumentation:spring:spring-integration-4.1:javaagent:test --tests '*FluxMessageChannelTest'`. Local configuration failed before the target test ran: while configuring `internal-application-logger/bootstrap/build.gradle.kts`, Gradle rejected mutation of `:javaagent:bootstrapLibs` after `:javaagent:licenseReportDependencies` had consumed it. No tests executed in that local attempt and the worktree remains unchanged.

Separate latest-deps CI for this same commit did execute `:instrumentation:spring:spring-integration-4.1:javaagent:test` (run 40045654929, `testLatestDeps1`, successful). Its log includes `FluxMessageChannelTest.shouldPropagateEmitterContextThroughSubscribeTo()` and the task succeeded, so the latest-deps `testLatestDeps()` branch—including the different-thread assertion—passed. The latest selected Spring Integration is 5.5.20; its POM declares Reactor Core 3.4.34. No code correction or commit was needed.
